# GAO open-recommendations export excerpt

`open-recs-2026-09-28-excerpt.csv` is SpicyDocs' fixture of the same name
(`tests/fixtures/gao_recommendations/`, 41,835 bytes, SHA-256
`fb6f8a6b1fa91fc258b23032f08b58cbb65d168fb41abcd49d3fad5f3ba8fee2`): GAO's
export of 2026-09-28 cut to its preamble, header and 35 records, byte for byte,
directors' phones as GAO prints them. Its README lists why each record was
kept. Fourteen records state a director phone (eight distinct values), which
is what the phone tests look for. U.S. government work, public domain.
